profile.headline: Software Developer @ Park Place Technologies | AI-Driven Development, API Integration, Data Reliability
profile.summary:
Currently a Software Developer at Park Place Technologies, contributing to backend integrations for enterprise network monitoring tools using Groovy, SNMP, REST, and other protocols. This role has reinforced practical skills in backend development, debugging, and collaboration within Agile workflows.  

Pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science at Cleveland State University, expected to graduate in May 2026. Passionate about building robust systems and exploring practical applications of AI. Seeking full-time opportunities in Software Engineering or AI Development to continue learning and solving complex challenges.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented Groovy collectors to integrate new network devices using SNMP, REST, SSH, and CLI protocols, transforming raw device data into structured XML.

• Improved system reliability by debugging protocol-specific issues and refining XML parsing logic to ensure accurate, consistent reporting across integrations.

• Resolved bug tickets and enhanced existing collectors, expanding platform coverage and improving stability across monitored infrastructure.

• Collaborated with a cross-functional engineering team in Agile sprints, contributing to code reviews, weekly standups, 1-on-1s, and Jira-based task management.

• Strengthened backend development skills through hands-on work in API integration, network communication, and data reliability testing within large-scale enterprise environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Valley View, Ohio, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Enhanced efficiency by streamlining import/export processes between databases through the development and implementation of enhancements for an internal Data Editor tool using C#/ASP.NET, UI using Windows Forms, and SQL Server, resulting in a reduction in data transfer time.

• Increased real-time data accuracy by engineering a dynamic feature within the Data Editor to automatically update the session’s database list when databases are added or removed from connected servers, using C#/ASP.NET, ensuring up-to-date database availability.

• Maintained three servers consisting of over 50 databases and 5,000+ tables, ensuring optimal performance and uptime using SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio.

• Delivered service and support to over 100 police, fire, and dispatch agencies across Ohio and surrounding states, collecting feedback to improve service quality and user satisfaction.

positions.title: Associate Banker
positions.description:
• Assisted bank clients with transactions some of which include, deposits, withdrawals, payments, and monetary purchases, and referring customers to bankers
• Educated clients about the diverse products that we offered and introduced them to the variety of opportunities that they can take advantage of through the company
• Handled sensitive information and safeguarded clients’ and the firm’s integrity
• Balanced my assigned teller cashbox on a consistent basis
• Remained alert at all time of fraud efforts in bank transactions, which include, but are not limited to, counterfeit checks, forged identification, and transaction structuring to avoid specific financial positions

projects.title: PetPulse: AI-Powered Pet Health Wearable & Companion App
projects.description:
Role: Project Manager | Software Engineer | AI Engineer

End-to-end development of an IoT wearable system and mobile application that utilizes machine learning to continuously monitor, classify, and report canine activity and vital health metrics.

Key Contributions:
- Data Pipeline & Machine Learning: Architected the data processing pipeline to ingest raw sensor telemetry from the wearable device, applying ML models to classify behavioral patterns and detect health anomalies in real time.

- Generative AI Integration: Engineered an automated AI health summary feature that synthesizes complex time-series telemetry and ML classifications into actionable, natural language daily wellness reports for end users.

- Full-Stack Application Development: Engineered a responsive companion mobile application to visualize device data, providing users with intuitive dashboards and real-time alerts.

- Modern Engineering Workflows: Accelerated the development lifecycle and maintained high production standards by integrating advanced AI-assisted tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into the daily workflow.

- CI/CD & Code Quality: Enforced robust code quality and continuous integration by utilizing CodeRabbit for automated, AI-driven pull request reviews and rapid iteration.
